DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どのようなご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: What would you like to discuss?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: なくした袋を見たかもしれないと友人から連絡が来ました。いつの話かまだ分からないので、今ある場所として決めず相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人の似た品の目撃連絡を未確定として相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: A friend contacted me saying they might have seen the bag I lost. I do not yet know when, so I would like to discuss it without assuming that is where it is now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that a friend's report of a similar item is unconfirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 友人の方は、何とおっしゃいましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 駅のベンチに似た青い袋があったと言いました。私の袋と確認したわけではなく、見た時刻も聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 連絡の内容と未確認の時刻を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: They said there was a similar blue bag on a station bench. They did not confirm it was mine, and I have not asked when they saw it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese what was reported and that the time is unconfirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 時刻と特徴を、ご友人へ確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Can you check the time and the features with your friend?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 聞きます。似た色だけで私の物だと取りに行くより、どのベンチかも確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 場所時刻特徴を友人へ聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will ask. Rather than going to collect it just because the color is similar, I will also check which bench it was.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask your friend about the location, time and features. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 昨日の夕方、入口近くのベンチでした。今もあると見たわけではありません。私の名前札は確認していないそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 過去の目撃で本人確認がないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: It was on a bench near the entrance yesterday evening. They did not see that it is still there now. Apparently they did not check my name tag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that it was a past sighting and ownership was not confirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その情報を、ご自身の経緯と分けて伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will take that information separately from your own account.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。友人の昨日の目撃情報として伝えます。私が最後に使った場所と袋の特徴は、別に説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 伝聞と本人の経緯を分けて説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I will report it as my friend's sighting yesterday. I will separately explain where I last used the bag and its features.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Separate the secondhand report from your own account. Explain in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。情報の時刻と確認の範囲を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will ask when the information dates from and what was actually checked.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日は何をお送りになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: What will you be sending today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 同じ家に住む兄弟へ、二人分の贈り物を一箱で送ります。外側の受取人と、中の二つの品を整理したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同居する二人の贈り物を一箱で送ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am sending gifts for two brothers who live in the same house in one box. I would like to clarify the recipient on the outside and the two items inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that gifts for two people living together will be sent in one box.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お二人の住所は同じと確認できていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you confirmed that they have the same address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、本人たちに聞きました。二つの家へ分けて届けてもらうのではありません。一つの住所へ送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一住所への配送と確認済みの同居を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, I asked them directly. I am not asking for separate deliveries to two houses. I will send it to one address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese the delivery to one address and their confirmed shared residence.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 中の品も、相手に分かるようご準備ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please also prepare the items inside so the recipients can tell whose they are.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: それぞれの包みに名前を書きます。外側は受取る兄の名前を使うと相談して決めました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 内側の各名と外側の受取人を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will write a name on each package. We discussed it and decided to put the older brother's name on the outside, as he will receive it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decide the names on the inner packages and the outer recipient. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 弟の方へも、その送り方を伝えましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you told the younger brother about this arrangement too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。兄が一箱で受け取って分ける予定です。内側に名前を書いただけで、配達時に二人へ個別に渡すと考えてはいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同居者へ受取り分配の合意を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. The older brother will receive the one box and divide the gifts. I do not assume that writing names inside means the delivery person will hand each gift separately to each brother.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese the co-residents' agreement on receipt and distribution.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 箱の梱包状態を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will check how the box is packed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。住所一つ、受取人は兄、中は二人分です。包みの名前を確かめてから閉じました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 住所受取人中身の対応を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. One address, the older brother as recipient, and gifts for both inside. I checked the names on the packages before sealing it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the correspondence between the address, recipient and contents. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。発送方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will explain the shipping methods.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どの方法をご希望でしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 案内の最初の方法に丸を付けようとしましたが、私の目的に合うか確認していません。先に何をしたいか話してもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 案内順ではなく目的から方法を選びたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was about to circle the first method in the guide, but have not checked whether it suits my purpose. May I first explain what I want to do?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you want to choose by purpose rather than the order in the guide.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Yes. Please tell me your purpose.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 毎回窓口へ来る時間が取りにくいので、家で確認できる方法を知りたいです。すぐに全部の方法へ申し込むつもりではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家で確認したい目的と申込範囲を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is difficult to find time to come to the counter every time, so I would like to know a method I can check at home. I do not intend to sign up for all the methods immediately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese your wish to check at home and the limits of your intended application.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 利用できる方法と準備する物をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will explain the available methods and what to prepare.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。最初に載った物が私に一番よいと考えず、家で使うために何が必要か比べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自宅利用の準備条件を比較する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. Without assuming the first listed method is best for me, I will compare what I need to use them at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Compare the preparation requirements for use at home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご自宅で使える機器はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have equipment you can use at home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 携帯はありますが、パソコンはありません。使える物を伝え、対応が確認できてから方法を選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 手元の機器と不足を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have a mobile phone, but no computer. I will tell you what I can use and choose a method after confirming compatibility.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese what equipment you have and what you lack.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 案内をお持ち帰りいただくこともできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can also take the guide home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。今日は条件を聞いて持ち帰ります。目的と手元の機器に合うか見て、申込みは後にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 条件を持ち帰り申込を保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. Today I will ask about the requirements and take it home. I will see whether it suits my purpose and equipment, and apply later.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Take the requirements home and defer applying. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。利用方法の説明から始めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Let us begin by explaining how to use the methods.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。商品についてご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Would you like to ask about a product?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日買った保存容器について聞きたいです。同じ店名なのでこちらへ来ましたが、レシートの支店が違いました。どこへ問い合わせるか先に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同じ店名でも購入支店が違うため相談先を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to ask about a storage container I bought yesterday. I came here because the store name is the same, but the branch on my receipt is different. I would first like to check whom to contact.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the store name is the same but the purchase branch differs, and check where to ask.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: レシートの購入店は、どちらとありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which store is shown on your receipt?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 駅前店です。ここは公園前店ですね。店名の共通部分だけを見ていました。昨日買った容器は袋のまま持っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: レシートの駅前店と今いる公園前店を区別して品を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: The station-front branch. This is the park-front branch, right? I only looked at the shared part of the name. I have brought yesterday's container still in its bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish in Japanese the receipt's station-front store from the current park-front store and show the item.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 購入した店舗への問合せ方法をご確認ください。今日はどの内容をお尋ねになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check how to contact the purchase branch. What would you like to ask today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 贈る予定が変わったので、未使用の品を返せるか聞きたいです。別の支店でも必ず受け付けるとは考えず、購入店へ条件と持参物を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 予定変更による未使用品の返品可否と持参物を購入店へ聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: My gift-giving plans changed, so I want to ask if I can return the unused item. Rather than assuming another branch will accept it, I will check the conditions and what to bring with the purchase branch.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask the purchase branch in Japanese whether an unused item can be returned after a change of plans and what to bring.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 購入した時刻や、商品の状態は説明できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Can you explain when you bought it and its condition?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 昨日の夕方です。レシートの印字は午後六時で合っています。使っていませんが、そのことだけで返金が決まったとは言わず、包装も今の状態のまま示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 購入日時と未使用状態を伝え返金確定とはしない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yesterday evening. The receipt correctly says six p.m. I have not used it, but will not say that alone guarantees a refund, and will show the packaging in its current condition too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State the purchase date, time and unused condition without claiming a refund is confirmed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 購入店へ連絡してから、持って行く予定をお決めください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Contact the purchase branch before deciding when to take it there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。レシートの駅前店を確認し、品名と購入日時、未使用の状態を伝えます。必要な物と対応を聞いてから行き、今日はここへ品を置いて帰りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: レシート品名日時状態で問い合わせ対応確認後に訪問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will check the station-front branch on the receipt and tell them the item name, purchase date and time, and that it is unused. I will go after asking what is needed and how they will handle it, and will not leave the item here today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Contact them with the receipt, item name, purchase time and condition, then visit after confirming their response. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。購入店へ伝える内容が整理できました。問合せ先の案内をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. You have organized what to tell the purchase branch. Please check the contact information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 地図のご案内でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like help with the map?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人と一緒に見たいのですが、向かい合っているので一人には逆さです。並んで読める場所へ移りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二人が同じ向きで地図を読む場所を探す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to look at it with my friend, but as we are facing each other, it is upside down for one of us. We would like to move somewhere we can read it side by side.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Find a place where both people can read the map facing the same way. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらのベンチで、隣に座れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can sit next to each other on this bench.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そこで同じ向きにします。地図だけぐるぐる回すより、北の印と今の位置を二人でそろえます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 紙と現在地の向きをそろえる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: We will face the same way there. Rather than repeatedly rotating just the map, we will align the north marker and our current location together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Align the paper map and your current location. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 行きたい場所は決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Have you decided where to go?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 池です。友人が目印を探し、私は道の線を追います。二人が別々の目的地を指ささないよう先に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 目的地と読む役割を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: The pond. My friend will find landmarks, and I will follow the route lines. We will check first so we do not point to different destinations.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Divide the roles in reading and confirm the destination. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 途中の分かれ目も見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also check any forks along the way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一つあります。そこでどちらへ進むか二人で確認します。友人が先に歩いたら必ず合っているとは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 分かれ目で二人が確認する方法を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: There is one. We will check together which way to go there. I will not assume my friend is necessarily right just because they walk ahead.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese how both of you will check at the fork.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご準備はできましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。同じ向きで池までの道と分かれ目を見られました。地図をしまい、分かれ目でまた開いて二人で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 道を共有し途中で地図を再確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. Facing the same way, we could both see the route to the pond and the fork. We will put the map away and open it again at the fork to check together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Share the route and check the map again along the way. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。園内をお楽しみください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この路線図の二つの色を見分けにくいです。色の名前ではなく、路線名と駅名で乗換えを教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 色に頼らない路線名と駅名での案内を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have difficulty distinguishing these two colors on the route map. Could you explain the transfer using line names and station names rather than color names?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request directions by line and station names without relying on color. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 目的地の駅名はお分かりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you know your destination station's name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 公園前です。駅名の文字は読めますが、線の色をたどると途中で別の線へ移ってしまいそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 目的駅を示し色をたどる時の困り方を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Park-front. I can read station names, but if I follow the line colors, I may accidentally switch to another line along the way.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Name the destination and explain your difficulty following colors. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この図では、A線で中央駅へ行き、B線へ乗り換えて公園前へ向かいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: On this map, take Line A to Central Station, then transfer to Line B toward Park-front.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: A線、中央駅でB線、公園前ですね。その順番を文字でメモします。線を色分けして写すより、名前で残したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二つの路線と乗換駅を順に復唱して文字で記録する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Line A, then Line B at Central Station, then Park-front. I will write that sequence in words. I want to record the names rather than copy the routes in different colors.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Repeat the two lines and transfer station in order and record them in words. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 図の丸いAと四角いBの記号も、目印に使えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: The circular A and square B symbols on the map can also be landmarks.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 丸のAと四角のBを確認できました。乗場の表示にも路線名があるか聞きたいです。記号が見付からなければ、文字を見て係の方へ尋ねます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 図の文字記号を確認し乗場で路線名を探す方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have found the circular A and square B. I would like to ask if line names are also shown at the boarding area. If I cannot find the symbols, I will read the text and ask a staff member.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the map's text and symbols, and ask how to find line names at the boarding area. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 乗場や乗換先では、路線名と行先の案内をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Check the line names and destinations at the boarding and transfer areas.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。A線で中央駅、そこでB線へ乗り換え、公園前へ行きます。乗場では色だけで決めず、メモの路線名と行先を照らしてから乗ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 路線と乗換駅と目的地を確認し表示とメモを照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. Line A to Central Station, transfer there to Line B, then go to Park-front. At the boarding area I will not decide by color alone; I will compare the line name and destination against my note before boarding.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the lines, transfer station and destination, and compare signs with your note. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。分からなくなりましたら、メモを見せてお尋ねください。お気を付けてどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. If you are unsure, show your note and ask. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。どのようなご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to discuss?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 地域の交流会の案内を作っています。会場は希望を書いただけで、まだ予約できていません。この原稿を相談用として見ていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会場未予約の交流会原稿を相談用として示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am preparing an announcement for a local social gathering. I have only written the venue we hope to use; it is not booked yet. Could you look at this as a draft for discussion?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Present in Japanese a discussion draft for a gathering whose venue is not booked.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 原稿には、会場がどのように書かれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: How is the venue described in the draft?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 公民館の名前を大きく書きました。でも確定したように見えるので、希望会場で調整中と書き直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 会場確定に見える記載を調整中へ改めたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I wrote the community center's name prominently. But it looks confirmed, so I would like to change it to say it is our preferred venue and arrangements are underway.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you want to change wording suggesting confirmation to wording indicating arrangements are underway.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 会場利用については、予約の担当に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check with the booking staff about using the venue.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。まず希望日と人数を担当に伝えます。参加者へ配る案内は、予約の結果を聞いてから仕上げます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 希望日と人数を予約担当へ伝える順序を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. First I will tell the staff our preferred date and number of people. I will finish the announcement for participants after hearing the booking result.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese the order of telling booking staff the preferred date and attendance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 参加者へ、すでにこの原稿をお渡ししましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you already given participants this draft?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二人に相談のため見せました。参加募集を始めたわけではありませんが、会場はまだ決まっていないと改めて知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 原稿を見せた二人へ未確定だと再連絡する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I showed it to two people for discussion. I have not started recruiting participants, but I will tell them again that the venue has not yet been decided.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Inform the two people shown the draft again that it is unconfirmed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 相談用の原稿には、未確定の部分が分かるようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Make clear which parts of a discussion draft are unconfirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 日時も候補と書き、予約をお願いするための原稿として持って行きます。参加者へ知らせる版を作る前に、会場と日時の確認を済ませます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 候補日時の相談原稿と確定後の配布版を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will label the date and time as proposed too, and take it as a draft for requesting a booking. I will confirm the venue, date and time before making the version to send participants.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish the discussion draft with proposed dates from the distribution version after confirmation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。会場利用の担当へご案内します。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will direct you to the venue staff. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。受付で何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you at reception?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 仕事の日に眠気が気になります。休日は同じようには感じないので、両方の日のメモを診察で見せたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 仕事日と休日の眠気の違いを記録で示したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am concerned about feeling sleepy on workdays. I do not feel the same on days off, so I would like to show notes from both kinds of days during my consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you want to show records of the difference in sleepiness on workdays and days off.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どのような内容をメモされていますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 寝た時刻と起きた時刻、眠気を感じた時間です。仕事のない日の分も、気にならなかった日として残しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 睡眠時刻と眠気の時間と気にならない日の記録を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: When I went to bed and woke up, and when I felt sleepy. I also recorded days without work as days when it did not concern me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese your recorded sleep times, times of sleepiness and days without noticeable sleepiness.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そのメモを担当へお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please show those notes to the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。仕事が原因と決めて書いたのではありません。平日と休日で、朝食や出掛ける時刻も違うことを説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 生活の差を説明し原因は決めていないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I did not write them assuming work is the cause. I will explain that breakfast times and departure times also differ between weekdays and days off.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese the differences in daily routine and that you have not determined the cause.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: メモの記録は何日分ありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: How many days do the notes cover?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 先週の七日分です。一日は就寝時刻を忘れたので空欄です。ほかの日と同じ時刻で埋めず、覚えていないと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 七日分の記録と一日の未記録を申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: The seven days of last week. I forgot one day's bedtime, so it is blank. I will not fill it with the same time as other days, but will say I do not remember.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report seven days of records and the missing entry for one day. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 現在お困りのことも、診察でお話しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also discuss your current difficulties during the consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は電車で座っている時も眠かったです。仕事中だけという説明にせず、今日のことを足して相談します。記録を見ながら質問してもよいか担当に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今日の電車内での眠気を追加しメモで相談する希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Today I also felt sleepy while sitting on the train. I will add that when asking, rather than describing it as happening only at work. I would like to ask the person in charge whether I can refer to my notes while asking questions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Add today's sleepiness on the train and request to consult using your notes. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。記録と今日の様子をお伝えになりたいことを担当へ知らせます。お待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will tell the person in charge that you want to discuss your records and how you feel today. Please wait.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。どのようなご用件でしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 鍵を拾って持って来ました。写真の場所に落ちていたように見えますが、そこは私が端へ移した後の位置です。最初の場所も説明したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 鍵の写真は自分が移した後の位置だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I found a key and brought it here. The photo appears to show where it was lying, but that is its position after I moved it to the side. I would like to explain the original location too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the key's position in the photo is after you moved it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 初めはどちらにありましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 歩道の真ん中です。人が踏みそうだったので、植え込みの脇へ移してから写真を撮りました。鍵を拾ったのはその後です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 最初の位置と移動理由と拾った順を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: In the middle of the sidewalk. People might have stepped on it, so I moved it beside the planting bed before taking the photo. I picked up the key after that.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese the original position, reason for moving it and sequence of picking it up.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 場所が分かるよう、写真をお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please show the photo so we can identify the place.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この写真です。最初は白い線の横にありました。写真には鍵を置いた植え込みの側だけ写っているので、指で最初の位置を示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 写真にない発見位置を目印で示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here it is. It was originally beside the white line. The photo only shows the planting-bed side where I placed the key, so I will point to the original position.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Indicate the discovery location absent from the photo using a landmark. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 鍵には何か付いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Is anything attached to the key?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 赤い輪が一つ付いています。輪も初めからありました。私が拾った印として付けた物ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 鍵の付属品が発見時からあったと申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: One red ring. It was attached from the start too. I did not add it as a marker that I had found the key.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State in Japanese that the key's attachment was already present when found.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 発見した時刻を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please tell me when you found it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 午後二時ごろです。見付けた場所、端へ移した場所、今持っていることを順にお伝えしました。元の位置の写真はないので、この写真だけで判断しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 発見時刻と移動と保管の経緯を整理する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Around two p.m. I have explained in order where I found it, where I moved it to the side and that I now have it. I have no photo of its original position, so please do not judge from this photo alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Organize the discovery time, movement and custody history. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。鍵と、移した経緯を確認します。お届けありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will check the key and the circumstances of moving it. Thank you for bringing it in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。郵便のことで何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you with postal matters?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家に届いた封書ですが、宛名は前に住んでいた方です。まだ開けていません。私から転送先を書くことはできないので、取扱いを相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 前の住人宛ての未開封封書の取扱いを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: This sealed letter came to my home, but it is addressed to the former resident. I have not opened it. I cannot provide a forwarding address myself, so I would like to ask how to handle it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese how to handle an unopened letter addressed to the former resident.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 宛先の住所は、現在のお住まいと同じでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is the delivery address the same as your current home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 同じです。部屋番号も合っていますが、この名前の方は今は同居していません。私の家族の郵便ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 住所は合っているが名義人は同居していないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. The room number is correct too, but the person with this name does not currently live with me. It is not my family's mail.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the address is correct but the addressee does not live with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 封書の宛名を確認します。以前の方の転居先はご存じですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check the addressee. Do you know where the former resident moved?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 知りません。不動産会社から引っ越したと聞いただけです。連絡先も持っていないので、想像した住所を付け足すことはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 転居先と連絡先を知らないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: No. I only heard from the real estate agency that they moved. I have no contact details either, so I will not add an address I have guessed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you do not know their new address or contact details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この郵便物に、すでに何か書き込みをされましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you already written anything on this mail?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: していません。付箋に、自分が受け取った日だけ控えました。封筒へ新しい宛先を書かず、そのまま持って来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 受取日の控えと封筒に未記入であることを申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: No. I only noted the date I received it on a sticky note. I brought the envelope as it was without writing a new address on it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report in Japanese the note of the receipt date and that nothing was written on the envelope.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 取扱いを担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will check the handling procedure with the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。届いた住所は合っていて、宛名の方が今は住んでいないという相談です。受け取った日もお伝えしますので、必要な対応を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 住所と居住者の違いを整理し窓口の案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. The delivery address is correct, but the addressee no longer lives there. I will also tell you the receipt date, so please explain what I need to do.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Clarify the distinction between address and resident, and ask the counter for guidance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。宛名と状況を確認してご案内します。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will check the addressee and circumstances and explain. Thank you.
